title: Paired product sum after appending two coordinates
statement: Let $r,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $x\in\mathbb F_2^{r+2k}$, and let $a,b\in\mathbb F_2$. Append $a,b$ to $x$ to obtain a vector in $\mathbb F_2^{r+2(k+1)}$, and apply the paired-coordinate linear equivalence at level $k+1$. The sum of the products of the transformed coordinates in each of the $k+1$ designated pairs equals the corresponding sum at level $k$ for $x$, plus $\bigl(a+\sum_{i=1}^{r+2k}x_i\bigr)\bigl(b+\sum_{i=1}^{r+2k}x_i\bigr)$, with all arithmetic in $\mathbb F_2$.
